content: Kriti Mahajan called Karan Joshi from Safe Step Insurance to discuss a quote. Finding the annual premium of $1,380 too high because she plans to sell her car soon, Kriti opted for a 3-month term policy instead. Karan calculated the prorated premium to be $345 and agreed to process the policy and email the confirmation documents.

action_items: Send confirmation and policy documents via email to the customer
